   231→// VerifyTopicMapping verifies that the topic and its accompanying
   232→// message type is correct.
   233→func VerifyTopicMapping(topic string, msg interface{}) error {
   234→	msgType, ok := RPCTopicMappings[topic]
   235→	if !ok {
   236→		return errors.New("rpc topic is not registered currently")
   237→	}
   238→	receivedType := reflect.TypeOf(msg)
   239→	registeredType := reflect.TypeOf(msgType)
   240→	typeMatches := registeredType.AssignableTo(receivedType)
   241→
   242→	if !typeMatches {
   243→		return errors.Errorf("accompanying message type is incorrect for topic: wanted %v  but got %v",
   244→			registeredType.String(), receivedType.String())
   245→	}
   246→	return nil
   247→}

   249→// TopicDeconstructor splits the provided topic to its logical sub-sections.
   250→// It is assumed all input topics will follow the specific schema:
   251→// /protocol-prefix/message-name/schema-version/...
   252→// For the purposes of deconstruction, only the first 3 components are
   253→// relevant.
   254→func TopicDeconstructor(topic string) (string, string, string, error) {
   255→	origTopic := topic
   256→	protPrefix := ""
   257→	message := ""
   258→	version := ""
   259→
   260→	// Iterate through all the relevant mappings to find the relevant prefixes,messages
   261→	// and version for this topic.
   262→	for k := range protocolMapping {
   263→		keyLen := len(k)
   264→		if keyLen > len(topic) {
   265→			continue
   266→		}
   267→		if topic[:keyLen] == k {
   268→			protPrefix = k
   269→			topic = topic[keyLen:]
   270→		}
   271→	}
   272→
   273→	if protPrefix == "" {
   274→		return "", "", "", errors.Errorf("unable to find a valid protocol prefix for %s", origTopic)
   275→	}
   276→
   277→	for k := range messageMapping {
   278→		keyLen := len(k)
   279→		if keyLen > len(topic) {
   280→			continue
   281→		}
   282→		if topic[:keyLen] == k {
   283→			message = k
   284→			topic = topic[keyLen:]
   285→		}
   286→	}
   287→
   288→	if message == "" {
   289→		return "", "", "", errors.Errorf("unable to find a valid message for %s", origTopic)
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	for k := range versionMapping {
   293→		keyLen := len(k)
   294→		if keyLen > len(topic) {
   295→			continue
   296→		}
   297→		if topic[:keyLen] == k {
   298→			version = k
   299→			topic = topic[keyLen:]
   300→		}
   301→	}
   302→
   303→	if version == "" {
   304→		return "", "", "", errors.Errorf("unable to find a valid schema version for %s", origTopic)
   305→	}
   306→
   307→	return protPrefix, message, version, nil
   308→}
   309→
   310→// RPCTopic is a type used to denote and represent a req/resp topic.
   311→type RPCTopic string
   312→
   313→// ProtocolPrefix returns the protocol prefix of the rpc topic.
   314→func (r RPCTopic) ProtocolPrefix() string {
   315→	prefix, _, _, err := TopicDeconstructor(string(r))
   316→	if err != nil {
   317→		return ""
   318→	}
   319→	return prefix
   320→}
   321→
   322→// MessageType returns the message type of the rpc topic.
   323→func (r RPCTopic) MessageType() string {
   324→	_, message, _, err := TopicDeconstructor(string(r))
   325→	if err != nil {
   326→		return ""
   327→	}
   328→	return message
   329→}
   330→
   331→// Version returns the schema version of the rpc topic.
   332→func (r RPCTopic) Version() string {
   333→	_, _, version, err := TopicDeconstructor(string(r))
   334→	if err != nil {
   335→		return ""
   336→	}
   337→	return version
   338→}

   340→// TopicFromMessage constructs the rpc topic from the provided message
   341→// type and epoch.
   342→func TopicFromMessage(msg string, epoch primitives.Epoch) (string, error) {
   343→	// Check if the topic is known.
   344→	if !messageMapping[msg] {
   345→		return "", errors.Errorf("%s: %s", invalidRPCMessageType, msg)
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	beaconConfig := params.BeaconConfig()
   349→
   350→	// Check if the message is to be updated in fulu.
   351→	if epoch >= beaconConfig.FuluForkEpoch {
   352→		if version, ok := fuluMapping[msg]; ok {
   353→			return protocolPrefix + msg + version, nil
   354→		}
   355→	}
   356→
   357→	// Check if the message is to be updated in altair.
   358→	if epoch >= beaconConfig.AltairForkEpoch {
   359→		if version, ok := altairMapping[msg]; ok {
   360→			return protocolPrefix + msg + version, nil
   361→		}
   362→	}
   363→
   364→	return protocolPrefix + msg + SchemaVersionV1, nil
   365→}
